items.label: Introduction
items.value: We received your letter submitting the above Revised Statement of Variability for our review. We have reviewed it and wish to make the following Comment:

blocks.raw_markdown:
- **Introduction**: We received your letter submitting the above Revised Statement of Variability for our review. We have reviewed it and wish to
make the following Comment:
Re: Revised Statement of Variability for Form P 22550-I

1. The second sentence of the second paragraph of the Filing Description states: “The Statement of Variability was originally
approved by your Department on 08/09/2022 under SERFF Tracking Number AMGN-133229794…on a general use basis for in-state
or out-of-state scenarios”. The filing to which you refer is an out-of-state filing. Please revise the Filing Description and remove the
“in-state” reference, as we are only reviewing the Statement of Variability for use with a Certificate issued on an out-of-state basis.
We suggest that you provide a post-submission update to the General Information tab with the Revised Filing Description. See
COMAR 31.04.17.03C and rule #12 in the Comments section of the “Maryland General Instructions” under the SERFF “Filing Rules”
tab.

items.label: Conclusion
items.value: Thank you for your attention to these matters. We will give this submission our further attention when we receive your Response. Please include a cover letter with your Response that notes the change made in the Filing Description, and references the Comment noted in our letter. If you have any questions, or need further clarification, do not hesitate to call or email me. I am usually in the office from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (EST) Monday through Friday.

blocks.raw_markdown:
- **Conclusion**: Thank you for your attention to these matters. We will give this submission our further attention when we receive your
Response. Please include a cover letter with your Response that notes the change made in the Filing Description, and references the
Comment noted in our letter. If you have any questions, or need further clarification, do not hesitate to call or email me. I am usually
in the office from 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (EST) Monday through Friday.

Please be advised that failure to respond to this letter within 90 days of the date of this letter will cause the filing to be deemed
withdrawn in accordance with COMAR 31.04.17.05.  If you are interested in pursuing approval of a withdrawn filing, you will be
required to re-file the form(s), supporting documentation and filing fee.  It will then be treated as a new submission.
Sincerely,
Sebastian Schenk
